purpose: Reviewable change sets, authorized desired state, application and verification.
use: A change to source, configuration or content that must be reviewed and verified: define the change set, apply it, verify it against effective scope.
semantic_conditions: Desired, approved, applied and verified states stay distinct; scope expansions are re-evaluated.
mandatory_preconditions: Governing work item, reviewable change set and authorization for its scope.
postconditions_verification: Applied change verified against success criteria; outstanding effects tracked.
